headlines.title: Katie Zacharia is out as White House press secretary after just 5 days on the job
headlines.description: Katie Zacharia is out as White House press secretary after just five days on the job, sources said, following a widely panned first press briefing and the revelation that she represented herself as a lawyer but did not pass her bar exam. Earlier Friday, President Donald Trump said he would let Zacharia decide whether to remain as his press secretary after he suggested she was treated harshly by the media during her first week on the job.

headlines.title: Federal investigation of letters with suspicious substances widens
headlines.description: A federal investigation of letters containing unknown substances that were mailed to elected officials’ offices has expanded as some Republicans have been identified as targets of the mailings, a person with direct knowledge of the investigation told NBC News on Friday.

headlines.title: Democratic Senate candidates swamp GOP rivals in fundraising
headlines.description: Democratic candidates across more than a dozen competitive Senate races raised a combined $253 million from July through September, more than four times the $56 million raised by GOP candidates in those races.

headlines.title: A look back at President Trump’s past White House press secretaries
headlines.description: From Sean Spicer’s viral first briefing and the birth of “alternative facts” to Katie Zacharia’s abrupt exit, NBC News’ Julie Tsirkin takes a look back at the people who have briefed the press under President Trump.

headlines.title: Israeli settlers attack American journalist in West Bank
headlines.description: In the latest brutal attack by Israeli settlers against Palestinians in the West Bank, a Washington Post photographer is now among the casualties. NBC News’ Matt Bradley reports from the region.

headlines.title: White House Press Secretary out after 5 days on the job
headlines.description: Katie Zacharia had a rocky five days as White House Press Secretary with a single briefing that was widely panned followed by questions over her legal credentials. Now she is out from one of the highest profile posts of the Trump administration. NBC News’ Chief White House Correspondent Garrett Haake reports.

headlines.title: Drive to Decision Day: Voters sound off on the economy, war and Washington
headlines.description: With the midterm elections almost here, NBC News’ Jonathan Allen wanted to find out if Americans are frustrated enough with President Trump and Republicans to vote Democrats into power in the House and Senate. So he hopped in a van and drove 1,800 miles from New Jersey to Nebraska to meet with voters in eight battleground districts.

headlines.title: As Trump pushes for data centers, voters in key midterm races say they don’t want them
headlines.description: An NBC News Decision Desk Poll found that 69% of respondents oppose building AI data centers in their areas, with 45% saying they “strongly oppose” the idea.

headlines.title: ‘Fed up with a war they didn't want’: Midwestern voters air frustrations impacting the midterms
headlines.description: Senior National Politics Reporter Jonathan Allen joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss his conversations with frustrated voters on the ground in Iowa and Ohio ahead of the midterms in his Drive to Decision Day series.

headlines.title: Trump ‘doesn’t have a plan’ on Iran: Voters in key Pennsylvania district upset with handling of war
headlines.description: NBC News Senior National Politics Reporter Jon Allen hits the road for his Drive to Decision Day series to talk to voters in several battleground congressional districts that could determine the control of Congress. Jon Allen starts his road trip in New Jersey’s 7th congressional district and Pennsylvania’s 7th and 8th congressional districts.

headlines.title: 'Dear Donald': Battleground district voters share their message to Trump
headlines.description: On his final day of the NBC News Drive to Decision Day series, NBC News senior national politics reporter Jon Allen joins Meet the Press NOW from Nebraska to recap his trip and hisvisit to the “blue dot” district.

headlines.title: 'I am not running for president,' Attorney General Todd Blanche says at Iowa State Fair
headlines.description: On day five of his Drive to Decision Day series, NBC News senior national politics reporter Jon Allen joins Meet the Press NOW to break down his one-on-one with Attorney General Todd Blanche at the Iowa State Fair in Des Moines.
